children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Move between pinned releases with backups, release notes, rendered values, migration checks, staged validation, and an explicit rollback decision.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Do not combine a platform upgrade with unrelated server, storage, authentication, or network changes.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Read release notes and compatibility constraints, export current values, inventory CRDs, and verify recent recoverable backups.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Record current chart, image, CRD, Kubernetes, and database versions.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Check deprecated values and any required manual migration steps.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Choose a maintenance window with clear success and rollback criteria.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Upgrade a non-production or canary environment first, then watch migrations, rollouts, conditions, events, logs, and core workflows.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Diff rendered manifests and values before applying the chart.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Verify login, cluster health, server reconciliation, console, and backups.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Pause when observed errors are unexplained rather than stacking retries.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Use the release-specific rollback procedure only when data and CRD compatibility are understood.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Backups verified; values exported; release notes and diff reviewed

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Canary healthy; migrations complete; core workflows tested

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Production observed; version recorded; rollback window closed

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Helm cannot auto-update CRDs, but the chart's autoApply hook applies them server-side. From v0.3.0, Helm 4 needs --force-conflicts on a first install over v0.2 CRDs.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Breaking: admin-level grants need `*`, and probes reach only probe ports. Telemetry is on by default for new installs. Password reset ends all sessions. Full list in the CHANGELOG.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: GameServers roll once for network capture volume. Owner-only server operations (transfer, collaborate, wipe, delete). Playit tunnel egress widened. Tunnel Secrets must be owned by GameServer.
